en.title: Fixed prepositions with verbs and adjectives
en.summary: Some verbs and adjectives always take a particular preposition.

paragraphs: Some verbs and adjectives are always followed by a particular preposition.
These pairs must be learned together, because the same meaning may need a different preposition in another language. After a preposition, a verb takes the -ing form.
